observations: Photo 0: a V8 petrol engine with a long automatic gearbox still bolted to it, out of a vehicle, lying on bare ground in a workshop yard.
Photo 0: the gearbox case is dusty with blue paint marks, a long tail housing ending in an output flange, wiring and cooler lines still attached.
Photo 0: a watermark reading 'GEARUP IN...' runs across the gearbox, so the photo carries a dealer's mark.
Photo 0: no transmission ID tag, part number or VIN is readable; nothing in the photo says GMC, Sierra or a year.
Photo 0: no clip of it running, no fluid shown, no view of the bell housing or torque converter.
Photo 0: a loose metal bracket lies on the ground at the bottom left; a man works on something in the background.

identity.kind: used automatic gearbox for a V8 pickup truck
read_from: photo 0 shape of the unit: automatic gearbox bolted to a V8 engine; no plate or tag readable

claims.evidence: No tag, part number or VIN is readable in photo 0. The claim also spans model years that normally carry different gearboxes, so one unit fitting all of them is doubtful until the tag is shown.

claims.claim: Direct America (foreign used, imported from the US)
claims.evidence: Origin cannot be shown by a photo of the part.
No clip of the gearbox running or shifting; the unit is out of any vehicle in photo 0.

risks.risk: Gearbox slips, fails to shift or has internal damage
risks.proof: A clip of the gearbox in a running vehicle or on the engine shifting through all gears, plus a photo of the fluid on the dipstick or drain plug
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, a core for rebuild or scrap

risks.risk: Wrong model or fitment: it may not be the gearbox for the GMC Sierra years claimed
risks.proof: A sharp close-up of the transmission ID tag or stamped number on the case
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lowest value V8 automatic gearbox of unconfirmed fitment

risks.risk: Torque converter, control module or transfer case missing
risks.proof: A photo of the bell housing side once separated showing the torque converter, and of the rear showing whether a transfer case comes with it
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare gearbox without torque converter, module or transfer case

risks.risk: The watermarked photo may be a dealer's stock picture and not the unit on offer
risks.proof: A fresh photo of the gearbox with a handwritten note carrying today's date and a code we give
risks.if_unproven: priced only on what that photo shows, with no extras assumed

risks.risk: Engine in the photo is not part of the sale
risks.proof: Seller confirms in writing whether the engine is included

proof_requests: Close-up of the transmission ID tag or stamped number on the gearbox case
Clip of the gearbox running and shifting through all gears
Photo of the gearbox with a handwritten note carrying today's date and a code we give
Photo of the bell housing side showing the torque converter, and the rear end
Photo of the gearbox fluid on the dipstick or drain plug
Written confirmation of whether the engine is part of the sale
response.reason: Photo 0 clearly shows a used automatic gearbox for a V8 truck, so it can be priced by type at its worst case, as a non-working unit of unconfirmed fitment. The ID tag and a shifting clip would raise it.
